Floors & tills

Which storey each till stands on — and so what its bills are called.
FY 26 · next reads like TG26-001 Bill series
A bill number is built from Till Floor Prefix TG Year 26 Number -001 A cashier never types one and cannot change one.
Floors are created in the warehouse. The chain warehouse → store → floor → till is one master, kept in the Essa warehouse's Locations screen, and this shop mirrors it. Rows marked Warehouse are read-only here — change them there and they follow on the next sync. Anything added on this page is Local and left alone by a sync, for a shop running on its own.
